beats.text: Splitting bills with roommates usually means awkward texts and rigid fifty-fifty math. Meet Margin: the privacy-first home planner that keeps roommates in sync.
Instead of a flat fifty-fifty split that ignores different incomes and personal essentials, Margin calculates each roommate's true available margin, so everyone contributes the same fair effort.
Track recurring bills by due date, mark month-specific paid status, and export to C S V, or preview a one-twenty dollar what-if expense side by side without touching your saved plan.

Need to bring up a bill change? Margin's AI coach runs Google Gemma 4 on Cloudflare Workers AI. Only your chosen goal and tone reach the cloud, while real names and dollar amounts are added strictly on your device.
And with Margin's local password vault, your plan is encrypted in the browser with A E S two-fifty-six G C M, and locks automatically on every reload.
Margin. Elevate the ordinary kitchen-table budget. Try it live at get margin dot pages dot dev.
